notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — NC implementation is the first genuinely complex algorithm in this codebase; the bitmask invariant and trust-anchor NC gap are the two places most likely to generate a maintenance surprise.
Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: the NC intersection algorithm correctness under pathological multi-CA overlap (hard to trace mentally); the empty-subject DN false rejection (no PKITS test exercises this case). Uncertainty driven by: NC state machine has many interaction paths; PKITS covers only standard conforming certs. Would raise confidence if: a test with empty-subject cert through an NC-constrained CA were added.
Idiom rating: CLEAN — Clippy passes with -D warnings. The only Rust-specific finding is a cargo fmt failure on two lines in pkix-chain (not in the new NC code itself). The NC implementation uses idiomatic Rust: no gratuitous clones, proper use of iterators, no unwrap outside tests.
Rust idiom confidence: 90% chance of no missed issue. Least confident flags: the GeneralSubtrees clone() pattern in NC intersection (necessary but could be restructured with Cow if allocation becomes a concern). Uncertainty driven by: no profiling data on chain validation hot paths.
title: Review: NameConstraints + OCSP/CRL fixes
